battle.name: 千人隊遠征
battle.theater: 西西里島西部與那不勒斯灣
battle.brief: 一八六〇年五月十一日，加里波第率一千零八十九名志願者自熱那亞出海，在西西里馬爾薩拉登陸，經卡爾塔菲米、米爾措直取巴勒莫，再渡海峽入那不勒斯，十月一日於沃爾圖爾諾擊潰波旁軍，圍困加埃塔至翌年二月陷落。志願軍所攜的十四點七毫米雷管步槍，正是皮埃蒙特軍同族步槍的母型，山地射擊由它定調。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰雙方是義大利統一運動的志願軍與撒丁王國聯軍，對手是兩西西里王國的波旁王室軍隊，並得到教皇國的支援。志願軍這邊的核心是一八六〇年五月五日自熱那亞庫阿爾托海角出發的一千零八十九名志願者，通稱「千人隊」，以朱塞佩·加里波第為總司令；後方有西西里解放委員會與撒丁政府的雙重支持——海軍上將卡洛·佩利翁·迪·佩爾薩諾奉命掩護登陸，卡富爾於四月十八日先派「戈沃諾洛」與「奧提翁」兩艦赴西西里偵察，並由魯巴蒂諾船公司把「皮埃蒙特」號與「倫巴第」號蒸汽郵船秘密租給志願軍。志願軍編制上分為本隊、西西里義勇、匈牙利兵團（以伊什特萬·蒂爾為首）、英國志願者小隊與後來組成的阿爾卑斯獵手隊；加里波第於七月七日設立的獨裁政府下設戰爭、內政、財政、司法、教育與宗教、外交與商務六部，就地徵發糧秣。撒丁王國由維克多·埃馬努埃萊二世主持，隨後以拉·馬爾莫拉、恰爾迪尼、范蒂等將領率正規軍與攻城砲兵入南。波旁一方是弗朗切斯科二世治下的兩西西里王國，陸軍編為一個近衛軍團與三個野戰軍團，現役約九萬人，另有外籍團充作骨幹，國王身邊有蘭迪、里圖奇、博斯科等將領，海軍尚有「斯特朗博利」號等四艘武裝船隻。場外還有兩股力量：英國皇家海軍的「阿格斯」號砲艇與「勇敢」號帆船戰艦在馬爾薩拉港內牽制了波旁艦隊，拿破崙三世的法國則在羅馬駐軍並護住教皇國，那條南北分界線決定了遠征的極限。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Garibaldian volunteers together with the army of the Kingdom of Sardinia on one side, and on the other the royal army of Bourbon-ruled Kingdom of the Two Sicilies, which had the support of the Papal States. The core of the volunteer column was the thousand and eighty-nine men who sailed from Quarto al Mare near Genoa on the night of 5 May 1860, generally called the Thousand, with Giuseppe Garibaldi as commander-in-chief. Behind them stood a double support: the Sicilian Liberation Committee in Genoa and the Sardinian government itself. Admiral Carlo Pellion di Persano was ordered to cover the landing, Cavour had already sent the corvettes Governolo and Authion to Sicily on 18 April to size up the situation, and the Rubattino shipping company secretly rented the steamers Piemonte and Lombardo to the expedition. The force was organised in the original Thousand, the Sicilian insurgents, a Hungarian legion headed by Istvan Tur, a small body of English volunteers, and the Hunters of the Alps formed later; the government Garibaldi set up in Palermo on 7 July, with six ministries of war, interior, finance, justice, public education and worship, and foreign affairs and commerce, requisitioned supplies locally. The Sardinian Kingdom, led by King Victor Emmanuel II, followed with regular troops, field artillery and siege guns under generals such as La Marmora, Cialdini and Fanti. The Bourbon side was the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies of Francis II, whose army was organised into one guard corps and three line corps, roughly ninety thousand men on active service, stiffened by foreign regiments, with generals Landi, Ritucci and Bosco around the king and a small squadron of armed Bourbon vessels, among them the corvette Stromboli. Two outside forces also mattered: the British corvette HMS Argus and the sloop HMS Intrepid lying in Marsala harbour deterred the Bourbon squadron from interfering, while Napoleon III's France kept a garrison in Rome and shielded the Papal States, and that frontier line between Italian north and south was to decide much of the campaign.
people: 朱塞佩·加里波第是整場戰爭的軸心。他一八〇七年生於尼斯，青年時投身拿坡里的反法戰爭，隨後流亡南美，在烏拉圭與阿根廷的內陸打過十餘年游擊，一八四八至四九年任羅馬共和國的守備軍指揮官，兵敗再度流亡；一八五九年第二次義大利獨立戰爭中，他率阿爾卑斯獵手縱隊越過山脈而名噪一時，一八六〇年三月應羅西諾·皮洛與弗朗切斯科·克里斯皮之請赴熱那亞主持遠征，決定以民間武力解放南部。他自稱以維克多·埃馬努埃萊二世之名統治西西里，卻拒絕伸手去碰教宗國的領土，與首相卡富爾的算計互相牴觸。熱那亞方面由朱塞佩·拉·馬薩主持解放委員會，尼諾·畢基奧帶人「接收」兩艘蒸汽船，並於五月七日率隊在塔拉莫內堡取走火藥、彈藥、三門舊砲與一百支步槍。皮埃蒙特方面，元帥卡洛·阿爾貝托·拉·馬爾莫拉在六月率軍入西西里接管戰區，恰爾迪尼與莫羅佐·德拉·羅卡分別攻向佩薩羅與佩魯賈，佩爾薩諾封鎖安科納；總理卡富爾本人則被國內危機與奧地利召集的華沙會議拖住，未能到泰亞諾。波旁方面的將領中，弗朗切斯科·蘭迪在卡爾塔菲米被擊敗，費迪南多·貝內文塔諾·德爾·博斯科在米爾措以榮譽投降，加斯帕雷·里圖奇死守加埃塔，元帥薩米埃萊·里切在沃爾圖爾諾中彈重傷，十月二十日不治；國王弗朗切斯科二世於九月六日帶軍離開那不勒斯退入加埃塔，最終在流亡中終老羅馬。西西里與南部的民眾是無名而關鍵的力量：巴勒莫的起義、卡塔尼亞的騷動、農村的響應，讓波旁軍的九萬人無法集結，也讓志願軍在每一段路上都有人引路。
peopleEn: Giuseppe Garibaldi was the pivot of the whole war. He was born in Nice in 1807, fought as a boy in the Neapolitan war against the French, then spent years in exile in South America as a guerrilla in the interior of Uruguay and Argentina, and in 1848-49 commanded the garrison army of the Roman Republic before being defeated and exiled again. In the Second Italian War of Independence of 1859 he led the Hunters of the Alps across the mountains and made a name for himself, and in March 1860 he went to Genoa to take charge of the expedition, answering the appeal of Rosolino Pilo and Francesco Crispi, and decided to liberate the south with a citizen army. He ruled Sicily in the name of Victor Emmanuel II, yet refused to lay a finger on the Papal States, and his plans collided with the calculations of Cavour. In Genoa the Liberation Committee was chaired by Giuseppe La Masa; Nino Bixio led the men who seized the two steamers, and on 7 May took the garrison at Fort Talamone, where the expedition obtained gunpowder, ammunition, three old cannon and a hundred rifles. On the Sardinian side the field marshal Carlo Alberto La Marmora came to Sicily in June to take over the theatre, Cialdini and Morozzo Della Rocca struck at Pesaro and Perugia respectively and Persano blockaded Ancona, while Cavour himself was absorbed by the crisis at home and by the congress Austria was gathering at Warsaw, and could not be present at Teano. Among the Bourbon commanders, Francesco Landi was beaten at Calatafimi, Ferdinando Beneventano del Bosco surrendered at Milazzo with the honours of war, Giosue Ritucci held out in Gaeta, and the field marshal Samuele Rice was wounded at the Volturno and died of his wounds on 20 October; Francis II left Naples on 6 September for Gaeta and spent his exile in Rome. The people of Sicily and the south were the nameless but decisive force: the risings in Palermo, the agitation in Catania and the response in the countryside kept ninety thousand Bourbon troops from ever concentrating and gave Garibaldi's columns a guide at every stage of the march.
kits: 卡面這件一八四〇年的法國雷管步槍，是這場戰爭裝備史的技術母型。法國陸軍一八四〇年制式步槍口徑十四點七毫米，槍身約一點三一公尺，連刺刀重約四點七公斤，線膛配錐形彈，一分鐘可射三至四發，有效射程約兩百公尺；雷管底火不受潮氣影響，單手壓槍即可裝填，對一支裝備雜亂、缺槍少彈的志願軍而言，「點火不必再顧火鍋」意味著不必再為火絨與雨水分心。皮埃蒙特的雷管步槍（modello 1849/1859）幾乎照搬這款法國式，而志願軍在熱那亞購得的步槍中，義大利製 modello 1860 單兵槍與英國恩菲爾德式雷管步槍同樣是十四點七毫米口徑的技術同族；波旁步兵裝備的一八二九年式舊步槍也屬雷管系列，兩軍真正的差距在瞄具精度與裝備整齊度，而非火器原理本身。火藥是義大利製黑火藥，紙藥包在雨季容易受潮，志願軍曾靠海運小包火藥與零散裝藥補救，最缺的仍是炮彈、鞋襪與藥品。砲兵方面，五月七日塔拉莫內的三門舊砲、七月二十四日米爾措要塞繳獲的守軍砲車、墨西拿撤出時運走的彈藥，都靠海運補回；但真正決定攻城與攻堅的，還是撒丁軍的野戰砲與攻城重砲，加埃塔圍城正是靠這些砲與海軍封鎖完成。運輸是這場戰爭最脆弱的一環：全島只有巴勒莫至馬爾薩拉一條約一百公里的鐵路，王軍曾用它向內陸運兵，志願軍的補給則全靠自熱那亞與里窩諾出發的二十多次船運。
kitsEn: The card's weapon, a French percussion rifle of 1840, is the technical parent of the whole equipment story of this campaign. The French army's model 1840 infantry musket had a 14.7 mm bore, a length of about 1.31 metres, a weight of roughly 4.7 kilos with bayonet, a rifled barrel firing conical bullets, a rate of fire of three to four rounds a minute and an effective range of about two hundred metres. The percussion cap was immune to damp and loading was a one-handed press of the bolt, so a volunteer army short of everything did not have to worry about frizzen, pan and wet powder. The Piedmontese percussion musket, modello 1849/1859, was very nearly a copy of the French pattern, while the rifles Garibaldi bought in Genoa, the Italian modello 1860 single-shot rifles and Enfield pattern percussion rifles, belonged to the same 14.7 mm technical family; the old modello 1829 muskets of the Bourbon infantry were percussion weapons too, so the gap between the two armies lay in sight alignment and uniformity of equipment rather than in the principle of the gun. The powder was Italian black powder and paper cartridges went damp in the rainy season, so the volunteers made up the difference with small parcels of powder carried by sea and with loose charges; what was scarcest of all was artillery ammunition, footwear and medicine. On the artillery side, three old cannon from Talamone on 7 May, the fortress guns taken at Milazzo on 24 July and the ammunition the Bourbons carried away from Messina were all replaced by sea transport; what really decided the sieges and the assaults was the field and siege artillery of the Sardinian army, and Gaeta fell to those guns combined with the naval blockade. Transport was the most fragile link of all: Sicily had a single railway of about a hundred kilometres between Palermo and Marsala, which the royal army used to move troops inland, while the volunteers depended on more than twenty sailings out of Genoa and Livorno.
tactics: 加里波第的戰術核心是以守待攻、用地形換人數。卡爾塔菲米一役，他以千人隊主體加五百名西西里義勇在山脊上佈成兩道縱列，讓弗朗切斯科·蘭迪的王軍縱隊在谷底展開再側擊其翼，志願兵不與數倍於己的密集隊形硬撞；那一場形似星形的接戰，後來成為義大利統一運動的象徵。志願軍整體作風接近游擊而非會戰：重在守住路口、村莊與山隘，逼王軍在陌生地形上反覆行軍；多在清晨與黃昏發動攻勢，避開正午暑熱與長距離縱隊行軍；槍械落後使他們格外依賴土牆與坡地，寧可把射擊節奏放慢，也不願在開闊地被密集火力壓垮。西西里階段的關鍵是節奏本身：志願軍以每日數十公里的推進拖住王軍，王軍主力卻受制於財政與兵源，遲遲無法集結；八月十九日渡海峽時，加里波第麾下已近兩萬人，對手號稱八萬人，比例仍不利，他靠奪取米爾措、墨西拿等要塞的砲火與彈藥持續補血。九月七日進入那不勒斯後，遠征軍沿卡普阿古道北進，在沃爾圖爾諾河兩側與王軍展開決定性會戰；加里波第本人在此役腰部中彈，仍被抬著繼續指揮，直到把王軍逐向北面的加埃塔與泰拉奇納方向。最後的加埃塔圍城則是純粹的砲兵攻城：撒丁軍在十一月四日接手，以攻城重砲與海軍封鎖壓制要塞，十一月頭十天約一萬七千名波旁士兵越過邊界退入教皇國的泰拉奇納，被教皇當局與駐羅馬的法軍解除武裝看管，圍城直至此後二月十三日守軍投降才告結束。
tacticsEn: The core of Garibaldi's method was to let the other side attack and to buy numbers with ground. At Calatafimi he deployed the Thousand and five hundred Sicilian insurgents in two lines along the ridge, so that Francesco Landi's royal columns deployed in the valley below and could be taken in the flank; the volunteers never collided head-on with a formation several times their size, and that star-shaped engagement later became the emblem of the Italian unification. The army as a whole fought closer to guerrilla war than to pitched battle: it held roads, villages and passes and forced the royal troops to march over ground they did not know; attacks were launched at dawn and at dusk to avoid the midday heat and long columns on the march, and the shortage of arms made them depend on walls and slopes, slowing the rate of fire rather than standing in the open against massed volleys. In the Sicilian phase the decisive factor was tempo: the volunteers advanced a few tens of kilometres a day and never let the royal army concentrate, while the Bourbon treasury and recruiting could not match them. When the strait was crossed on 19 August, Garibaldi had almost twenty thousand men against a royal force officially numbering eighty thousand, and he kept making up for the imbalance by seizing the guns and ammunition of fortresses such as Milazzo and Messina. After entering Naples on 7 September, the expedition marched north along the ancient road to Capua and fought the decisive battle on both banks of the Volturno; Garibaldi was shot through the waist there and was carried forward while still giving orders, until the royal army was pushed back towards Gaeta and Terracina. The siege of Gaeta was pure artillery work: the Sardinian army took over on 4 November, combining heavy siege guns with a naval blockade against the fortress, and during the first ten days of November about seventeen thousand Bourbon soldiers crossed the frontier into the Papal States at Terracina, where the papal authorities and the French garrison in Rome disarmed and interned them; the siege itself lasted until the garrison surrendered on 13 February of the following year.
data: 可以核對的數字大致如下：出發時在熱那亞庫阿爾托海角集合的志願者為一千零八十九人（另一說為一千一百六十二人），其中三百三十六人來自義大利各地、僅一百五十六人來自熱那亞本埠，另有三十三名外籍志願者，包括十四名來自奧地利統治下特倫蒂諾的義大利人，以及伊什特萬·蒂爾等四名匈牙利人；五月七日至塔拉莫內取到三門舊砲與一百支步槍。對手方面，兩西西里王國陸軍編為一個近衛軍團與三個野戰軍團，現役約九萬人、預備役逾五萬，全體動員可達十四萬三千五百八十六人。五月十五日卡爾塔菲米，志願軍約一千五百人（千人隊主體加五百名西西里義勇）對王軍約二千至四千人（史料分別記為二千、三千與四千）；到五月下旬，志願軍在巴勒莫方向增至四千人，其中三千二百人為西西里義勇。七月二十二日一批一千五百三十五名志願者抵達巴勒莫，多為倫巴第人；自五月二十四日至八月二十日，北方港口共出發二十多次船隊，運來約二萬一千名志願者。八月十九日渡海峽時，加里波第麾下近兩萬人，王軍號稱八萬人。十月一日沃爾圖爾諾之戰，王軍投入約五萬人，志願軍規模約為其一半，戰後南部軍總兵力記為約五萬人。合法性上的數字最為清楚：十月二十一日公投，那不勒斯王國人口六百五十萬、選民一百六十五萬，贊成一百三十萬二千零六十四票、反對一萬零三百零二票；西西里王國人口二百二十三萬二千、選民五十七萬五千，贊成四十三萬二千零五十三票、反對僅六百六十七票。時間上，自五月五日夜出發到十一月九日凌晨加里波第離開那不勒斯，前後六個月零三天。傷亡的精確數字各方記載分歧頗大，可以確定的是沒有一場戰役出現萬人級的傷亡。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The volunteers assembled at Quarto al Mare near Genoa numbered one thousand and eighty-nine men on departure, other accounts saying one thousand one hundred and sixty-two; three hundred and thirty-six came from the Italian regions, only one hundred and fifty-six from Genoa itself, and thirty-three were foreign volunteers, among them fourteen Italians from the Trentino under Austrian rule and four Hungarians including Istvan Tur. At Talamone on 7 May they took three old cannon and a hundred rifles. On the other side the army of the Two Sicilies was organised in one guard corps and three line corps, about ninety thousand on active service, more than fifty thousand in the reserve, and a total of a hundred and forty-three thousand five hundred and eighty-six on full mobilisation. At Calatafimi on 15 May about fifteen hundred volunteers, the Thousand plus five hundred Sicilian insurgents, faced between two thousand and four thousand royal troops, the sources giving two, three and four thousand; by the end of May the column had grown to four thousand in the direction of Palermo, three thousand two hundred of them Sicilian insurgents. On 22 July a batch of one thousand five hundred and thirty-five volunteers reached Palermo, mostly Lombards, and between 24 May and 20 August more than twenty sailings left the northern ports carrying about twenty-one thousand volunteers. When the strait was crossed on 19 August Garibaldi had almost twenty thousand men against a royal army numbered at eighty thousand. At the Volturno on 1 October the royal side put about fifty thousand men into the field and the volunteers were roughly half that size, the Southern Army afterwards being recorded at about fifty thousand in all. The clearest numbers of all concern legality: in the plebiscite of 21 October the Kingdom of Naples had 6,500,000 inhabitants and 1,650,000 voters, with 1,302,064 for annexation against 10,302 against it; the Kingdom of Sicily had 2,232,000 inhabitants and 575,000 voters, with 432,053 for and only 667 against. In time, from the departure on the night of 5 May to Garibaldi's departure from Naples in the small hours of 9 November, six months and three days elapsed. Casualty figures differ widely between sources, and the one thing that can be said with certainty is that no single battle of this campaign produced casualties on a scale of ten thousand.
cause: 一八六〇年的遠征，源於義大利統一運動在歐洲列強之間的處境。一八四八年革命與一八四九年羅馬共和國覆亡之後，奧地利重新控制中北義大利，民族統一只剩下以撒丁王國為核心、逐塊拿下仍握在奧地利、教皇與波旁手上的領地這一條路。一八五五年撒丁在克里米亞戰爭中與英法並肩作戰，一八五九年第二次義大利獨立戰爭在法國幫助下贏得倫巴第，但七月十一日維拉弗蘭卡停戰只把倫巴第交給撒丁，佛羅倫薩、摩德納、帕爾馬與羅馬涅省雖自五月起先後脫離舊主，教皇國的烏姆布里亞與馬爾凱仍在嚴密控制之下。三月二十四日都靈條約把薩伏依與尼斯割讓給法國，換來法國對托斯卡納與艾米利亞併入撒丁的默許；國王維克多·埃馬努埃萊二世與首相卡富爾自此更不敢與法國正面衝突，於是把希望寄託在一場「國內起義」上——既能解放南部，又不必承擔開戰的責任。志願軍這邊的推力來自另一端：朱塞佩·馬志尼三月二日致信西西里，說「加里波第必須來」；羅西諾·皮洛自米西拿走到皮亞納德伊格雷基，一路宣告要為加里波第的到來作準備；弗朗切斯科·克里斯皮破譯了四月二十七日發出的加密電報，說服加里波第相信島上起義已成熟。加里波第因此在三月至五月間完成募兵、購械、租船與訓練，把一場起義變成一次正規的渡海作戰。觸發最終決策的還有國際形勢：拿破崙三世對革命向來警覺，奧地利在北部邊境持續施壓，法國駐羅馬的守備軍護住教皇國；正是這種外部壓力，逼使志願軍把出航日定在五月的最後一週。
causeEn: The expedition of 1860 grew out of the position of the Italian unification movement among the European powers. After the revolutions of 1848 and the fall of the Roman Republic in 1849, Austria once more held the middle and north of the peninsula, and the only road left to national unification was to take the remaining Austrian, papal and Bourbon territories one by one, with the Kingdom of Sardinia at the head. Sardinia had fought alongside Britain and France in the Crimean War of 1855, and the Second Italian War of Independence of 1859 had won Lombardy for the kingdom with French help, but the armistice of Villafranca of 11 July gave away nothing more: although Tuscany, Modena, Parma and the Romagna had thrown off their rulers from May onwards, the papal Umbria and the Marche remained under tight control. The Treaty of Turin of 24 March 1860 ceded Savoy and Nice to France in exchange for French consent to the annexation of Tuscany and Emilia, and from that moment King Victor Emmanuel II and Cavour could no longer risk a frontal clash with France; they pinned their hopes on an insurrection from within, which would free the south without the burden of a declared war. The push from the other end came from the volunteers themselves: on 2 March Giuseppe Mazzini wrote to Sicily that Garibaldi must come; Rosolino Pilo walked from Messina to Piana dei Greci announcing that everything must be ready for his arrival; Francesco Crispi decoded the encrypted telegram of 27 April and persuaded Garibaldi that the rising in the island was ripe. Between March and May Garibaldi turned that insurrection into a proper seaborne operation, raising men, buying arms, chartering ships and drilling them. The final push was also international: Napoleon III was always watchful of revolution, Austria kept up the pressure along the northern frontier, and the French garrison in Rome shielded the Papal States. It was this external pressure that fixed the sailing date in the last week of May.
impact: 這場遠征改寫了義大利的版圖與政治秩序。公投把一場起義轉化為合法的國家統一：十月二十一日兩場公投的贊成票以壓倒性多數通過，十一月七日維克多·埃馬努埃萊二世進入那不勒斯，十一月四日起撒丁軍接管加埃塔圍城，翌年二月十三日加埃塔陷落、波旁王室最後的堡壘投降，一八六一年三月十七日義大利王國宣告成立，阿爾貝托憲章隨之推行到南部每一個省。統一帶來的不只是地圖上的空白：波旁王室的行政層、稅制、軍隊與貴族特權被整批撤換，波旁陸軍與海軍的官兵按原階級編入新王國軍隊，拒絕向新國王宣誓者被送進亞歷山德里亞與聖莫里齊奧·卡納韋塞的營地，另有大批人逃入南部山區，成為統一後南部治安的根源，撒丁軍一度需要十四萬人才能維持當地秩序。另一面是失望：志願軍在戰鬥中許諾的減稅與土地分配並未兌現，農民面對的是更高的稅與強迫兵役，西西里一度出現大規模反亂；革命陣營內部的共和派與王權派也因「誰來收割成果」而生裂痕。加里波第於十一月九日凌晨登上「華盛頓」號離開那不勒斯，退回卡普雷亞島，此後再無兵權。對歐洲，這場戰爭示範了一種不靠王朝聯姻而靠民間武力完成的統一，維也納與巴黎同時緊張，奧地利在十月二十六日召集華沙會議策劃對撒丁的制裁，卻被此起彼伏的危機牽制；普魯士也從中看到義大利牽制奧地利的可能，日後走向一八六六年普奧戰爭的同盟外交。
impactEn: This expedition redrew both the map and the political order of Italy. The plebiscite turned a revolt into a lawful unification: the votes of 21 October carried by an overwhelming majority, the king entered Naples on 7 November, the Sardinian army took over the siege of Gaeta on 4 November, Gaeta fell on 13 February of the following year with the last Bourbon strongpoint surrendering, and on 17 March 1861 the Kingdom of Italy was proclaimed, with the Statuto Albertino extended to every province of the south. Unification brought more than blank space on the map: the administrative machine, the taxes, the army and the privileges of the Bourbon court were replaced wholesale, officers and men of the Bourbon land and sea forces were taken into the new kingdom's army with their ranks intact, those who refused the oath to the new king were sent to the camps at Alessandria and San Maurizio Canavese, and many others took to the southern mountains and became the root of the brigandage that followed unification, at one point requiring a hundred and forty thousand Piedmontese troops to hold the south. There was disappointment too: the tax relief and the land redistribution the volunteers had fought for did not arrive, and the peasants met heavier taxation and compulsory conscription, with large-scale unrest in Sicily and a split inside the revolutionary camp between republicans and monarchists over who would harvest the result. Garibaldi boarded the Washington in the small hours of 9 November and returned to Caprera, and never held command again. For Europe the war demonstrated that unity could be achieved by citizens in arms rather than by dynastic marriage, and Vienna and Paris grew nervous at the same time; Austria summoned a congress at Warsaw on 26 October to coordinate sanctions against Sardinia, while Prussia began to see the value of Italy pinning Austria down, the alliance that would lead to the Austro-Prussian War of 1866.
result: 十月一日沃爾圖爾諾之戰是全役的轉折：王軍被切成數段，加里波第腰部中彈仍被抬著指揮，統帥薩米埃萊·里切中彈重傷，十月二十日不治，王軍士氣隨之崩解；九月七日加里波第進入那不勒斯，弗朗切斯科二世於前一日已帶軍退向加埃塔，把王國的防禦壓縮到最後一座要塞。十月十九日至二十一日遠征軍渡過海峽在本土完成會合，十月二十一日公投確認南部歸屬，疆域上一切看似已定，但加埃塔仍在抵抗：圍城自十一月五日起在攻城重砲與海軍封鎖下進行，十一月頭十天約一萬七千名波旁士兵越界退入教皇國的泰拉奇納被解除武裝，直到翌年二月十三日守軍才在飢餓與彈藥耗盡下投降，國王出逃流亡，兩西西里王國就此終結。遠征軍自身也在勝利中解散：志願兵一部編入王國軍隊，一部解甲歸鄉，一部隨加里波第於一八六二年再赴西西里；「千人隊」這個名號自此成為以少勝多、以民抗兵的代名詞，在歐洲與美洲被各種運動反覆引用。留下的教訓有兩條：槍械落後、編制鬆散的起義軍可以靠地形、民心與節奏擊敗數倍於己的正規軍；但最終收割戰果、頒布法律、登記公投、收編殘餘軍與維持秩序的，永遠是那個能在事後合法接管的國家。義大利的統一由加里波第用槍桿子打下來，卻由薩伏依王室與皮埃蒙特的官僚收編完成，兩者之間的縫隙，後來變成了南部長久的問題。
resultEn: The battle of the Volturno on 1 October was the turning point of the whole campaign: the royal army was cut into pieces, Garibaldi was shot through the waist and kept giving orders from a stretcher, the commander Samuele Rice was wounded and died of his wounds on 20 October, and the morale of the Bourbon troops broke with him. Garibaldi entered Naples on 7 September, the king having left the previous day with his army for Gaeta, compressing the defence of the kingdom into its last fortress. The expeditionary columns were brought together on the mainland between 19 and 21 October, and the plebiscite of 21 October confirmed the annexation of the south, so that everything looked settled territorially, yet Gaeta still held out: the siege opened on 5 November under the Sardinian army with heavy guns and a naval blockade, about seventeen thousand Bourbon soldiers crossed the frontier into the Papal States at Terracina in the first ten days of November and were disarmed, and the garrison surrendered only on 13 February, hungry and out of ammunition, the king fleeing into exile and the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies ceasing to exist. The expedition itself dissolved into its own victory: some volunteers were taken into the royal army, some went home, and some followed Garibaldi back to Sicily in 1862. The name of the Thousand became shorthand for the few defeating the many, for citizens in arms beating soldiers, and was borrowed again and again by movements across Europe and the Americas. Two lessons remained. A rebel army with poor arms and loose organisation could beat a regular force several times its size by using ground, popular support and tempo; and the side that harvests the results, issues the laws, registers the votes, absorbs the defeated units and keeps order is always the one that can legally take over afterwards. Italian unity was won with the rifle by Garibaldi, but it was taken over and codified by the Savoy monarchy and the Piedmontese bureaucracy, and the gap between the two became the long problem of the south.
